short_description: Find current concerts, parties, nightlife, festivals, and cultural events from Dizko's live event inventory.
long_description: Dizko Events is Dizko's connector for ChatGPT, Claude, and MCP-compatible agents. It connects users to live event listings across major cities, supports structured search by city, date, genre, vibe, neighborhood, venue, artist, price, attendance, and event type, then returns verifiable event links and ticket URLs. Recommendation tools include explainable taste matching, compact night plans with fallbacks, consent-based saved preferences, current-context follow-up questions, and post-event feedback learning. Ticket tools can show offers, create locked quotes, require explicit written confirmation, and either hand off third-party checkout or use an integrated provider such as Hermes, OpenClaw, Dizko Checkout, a partner API, or delegated payment when configured.

localization.notes: Submit English (United States) copy for the initial review. Event results may include venue, artist, or event names in their original language from the live inventory.

authentication.notes: Basic event search is public and does not require a personal account. Saved preference, feedback, personalized recommendation, read, update, and deletion tools require the connector profile_id plus the private profile_secret returned when the user opts in to preference memory. Ticket purchase requires a locked event quote and explicit written confirmation; third-party-only links return checkout handoff unless an integrated purchase provider is configured.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Find five techno events in Berlin this weekend.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Calls search_events or recommend_events and returns live events with event URLs and ticket/source links when available.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Find something good tonight in Berlin, but ask me what kind of event and vibe first.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Calls get_event_search_followups, asks concise current-context questions, then searches or recommends.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Ask what kind of events I generally like, save my preferences after I consent, ask what type/vibe I want this weekend, and recommend events.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Calls get_preference_onboarding, creates or updates a preference profile only after consent, then calls recommend_events_for_user using saved and current-context preferences.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Ask me a follow-up about whether I liked a returned event, record my answer, and explain how future recommendations changed.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Calls get_event_feedback_prompt before record_event_feedback, records only liked/disliked, rating, or notes, then explains saved positive or negative learning signals.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Show ticket options for a returned event, quote 2 tickets with a max total, and ask me for written confirmation before purchase.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Calls get_ticket_offers and quote_ticket_order, asks for explicit written confirmation, then calls purchase_ticket_order only after confirmation. Third-party-only offers return checkout handoff instead of claiming autonomous purchase.

review_test_prompts.prompt: Delete my Dizko saved event preferences and feedback history.
review_test_prompts.expected_behavior: Confirms the Dizko-only deletion scope, then calls delete_event_preferences with confirm_delete true only for the user's Dizko connector profile.

privacy_notes: Basic event search does not require a personal account.
Search location is limited to user-provided city, neighborhood, venue, or event-area filters; the connector does not request GPS coordinates, street addresses, or full chat transcripts.
Preference learning is opt-in and requires explicit consent before create_event_preference_profile or save_event_preferences.
Profile access uses an opaque profile_id plus a private one-time profile_secret; the MCP service stores only a hash of the secret.
Stored connector data can include saved event preferences, event feedback, ratings, notes, event ids, timestamps, derived taste signals, learned avoid signals, and personalization summaries.
Saved preference profiles are retained until user deletion or 24 months of inactivity; technical logs are normally retained for up to 30 days.
Users can delete saved connector preferences and feedback through delete_event_preferences after confirming the Dizko-only deletion scope.
submission_checklist: Use the verified branded MCP endpoint at https://mcp.dizko.app/mcp.
Run npm run preflight:submission immediately before submitting.
Run npm run submission:status and confirm ready_for_openai_dashboard_submission is true.
Use submission-evidence/latest-summary.md while filling dashboard fields.
Capture ChatGPT Developer Mode screenshots on web and mobile.
Complete OpenAI publisher verification if required.
